name: proto
description: Proto on your laptop: set up your account, import your product's design system, build prototypes, and serve them at public URLs.

PROTO_APP_URL.title: Proto app URL
PROTO_APP_URL.description: Your Proto app's address, for example https://<your proto domain>. It is the Proto app line of the setup prompt you copy from the site. Optional: once setup has run, the plugin reads it from ~/.proto/config.json.

PROTO_PROVISION_SECRET.title: Provisioning secret
PROTO_PROVISION_SECRET.description: The Provisioning secret line of the setup prompt you copy from the site. Optional: once setup has run, the plugin reads it from ~/.proto/config.json.
